Title: Public preview: Containerize and migrate apps to Azure Kubernetes Service with Azure Migrate: App Containerization

Body.Content:
App containerization is a new feature of Azure Migrate that helps you migrate applications to containers running on Azure Kubernetes Service. This capability augments the existing migration features in Azure Migrate such as migration of servers to Azure virtual machines and migration of SQL databases to Azure SQL etc. 

Learn more. 

Read the documentation.
